summary: Akanda Corp. filed a Form 6-K reporting that its special shareholder meeting, originally convened on April 27, 2026, was adjourned due to lack of a quorum (at least two holders of 10% of shares present). The meeting is reconvened on May 25, 2026. No business was transacted. This is a routine procedural adjournment, not a special situation. The filing discloses no transaction terms, board recommendation, or advisor. The event is a logistical delay to solicit more proxies. What to watch: whether quorum is achieved at the reconvened meeting; no risk-arb angle as there is no deal.
